Diagnosis.submission: Root cause: DNS resolution failure for user-service. The CoreDNS ConfigMap (kube-system/coredns) has an injected 'template' plugin block that returns NXDOMAIN for user-service.social-network.svc.cluster.local (match ^user-service.social-network.svc.cluster.local. rcode NXDOMAIN). As a result all clients fail to resolve user-service. compose-post-service logs: Thrift TSocket::open() getaddrinfo() <Host: user-service Port: 9090> Name or service not known, and (ClientPool.h:114:Pop) Failed to connect user-service-client. social-graph-service and nginx-thrift also fail (compose/post and home-timeline APIs report Could not resolve host for client socket / connection refused). The faulty component is the CoreDNS configuration, cascading into failures of user-service dependents and post/timeline APIs.
